authors: Mahoney JJ, Cadle SA, Jakubowski RT

notes: Carbonate controls the high-pH desorption edge: no-carbonate systems (Hsi) show minimum dissolved U at pH ~7 with U still sorbed at pH 9.6; with atmospheric CO2 U desorbs above pH 8. Optimised DLM constants: two uranyl-carbonate surface complexes (Hfo_wOUO2CO3-, Hfo_wOUO2(CO3)2 3-) included (Table 2). For a CO2-driven pH change in a natural water, DIC and pH covary, so the edge position is not fixed.
